Rams fight at a traditional sheep fighting during a Sundanese traditional cultural on January 23, 2022 in Sumedang, Indonesia. Ram fighting is part of Sundanese culture. Garut sheep have special characteristics for fighting like a more muscular physique than other sheep. The animals require exceptionally careful grooming, Ram owners take great pride in their sheep. To win, a ram must collect points in such criteria as good health, boldness in attacking, the beauty and condition of its horns, the type of its wool, etc. (Photo by Algi Febri Sugita/NurPhoto Stock Photo

sheep dexterity art

BANDUNG, 6/3- SENI KETANGKASAN DOMBA. Two Lamb Garut's tails follow the Lamb's Art in Siliwangi, Bandung, West Java, Sunday (6/3). The activities held by the Sheep Farmer and Kambing Indonesia (HPDKI) Bandung is a monthly activity to train Lamb Garut on the national level competition event, as well as to increase the livestock prices of the Lamb Garut owner. Photo ANTARA/Agus Bebeng/pd/11
